text.content:
Smith Kofrud Flinthand

- addresses them as “honorless mercenaries”

- is offended that they tried to hide and continue to hide their
identities

- is offended that they tried to smuggle in a warforged / war golem

- is offended that they have SSP pendants

- relays to the party the terms of their trial

- Trial of honor – committing dishonor / cowardice will consider it to
be failed and subject to being killed

- would rather have seen them killed as agents of the protectorate and
hung over the battlements

- views hiding their identity as cowardice, fit for sneak thieves,
spies, and criminals.

- the trial was not his call, but he will faithfully execute the orders
of the Master Smith.

Throkaen Stonecleaver

843-450 = 407- 450 = bc 43 + 400 = bc 433

Year 843 – TS 440 years old

TS born 403

Had son, Master Smith Gidrul Silverhammer, year 493)

Father, Hamac Frostbuckle, was 200 when TS born, Father born 203

Grandfather , Orduk Lightbender, was 250 when Father was born,
Grandfather born year 47 BC

- is old, approaching 450 years old

- his son is Master Smith Gidrul Silverhammer (350 yr old)

- runs the inn and prepares their dinner while talking

- is the son and grandson of the dwarves that headed up the creations of
the Sentinels at the gates.

- The sentinels were created as a response to an atrocity in the Great
War before the Cataclysm.

- The Dwarves were neutral at the time in the war. The Empire had
smuggled in a number of legions of war golems / metal men into the
Dwarven cities utilizing illusion magic. The Empire sprung their attack,
killing large number of Dwarves such that the streets ran with blood.

- The Dwarves fought back, and some called on their gods for help.
Moradin, and Thard Harr (the Storm god), among others, granted some of
them the powers of the Forge, allowing them to gain the upper hand
against the metal men / war golems.

- The streets ran as rivers with blood. In some places, the staining can
still be found.

- After the attack, the Dwarves, led by Grandfather created the
Sentinels as a ward against this happening again and force all travelers
to pass through the gates.

- As the cataclysm was 843 years ago, it is only a few Dwarven
generations removed, compared to 40 generations of Humans.

- The Empire was destroyed in the cataclysm, but the main part of it
reconstituted itself as the SSSP

- Throkaen was not a Smith, but a miner. He spent his youth expanding
and finishing the Halls of Memories to entomb the bones of the slain.

- Knows that every decade or so someone unearths a Warforged. Sometimes
when they turn them on they start killing everyone. Sometimes they just
walk in circles. Sometimes nothing. Sometimes like Warforged character –
sentient.

- “Everything comes from the Earth, and goes back to the Earth.
Sometimes people bury things to hide them, but its odd what you can dig
up.”

- Will ask the party to not try to escape the inn, last time someone
tried that, he had to clean them up with a mop and bucket. (warding
glyphs under the windows)

Sentinels – Fixed statues / objects that monitor city entrances

- True Seeing - Truesight to see through illusions / true form / shape
changers (Divination School)

- Detect magic operates in their area of effect (Divination)

- Through tokens/amulets, allows the guards to perceive detected things
/ anomalies

- Detects undead, aberrations, constructs, fey, Fiends, Celestials
(Divination)
